bull.b: Strong revenue growth alongside higher average selling prices indicates improving product appeal and mix, not merely greater unit volume. Premium adoption can support better economics, strengthen Amazfit’s brand positioning, and create a more durable foundation for future growth.

Expanding value share across EMEA, the United States, and Asia Pacific shows that Amazfit is gaining competitive traction in multiple important regions. A broader installed base can improve brand visibility, support ecosystem adoption, and make future product launches more effective.

The HYROX agreement gives Zepp a durable route to connect hardware, software, training content, and athlete-oriented data around a recognized global platform. This can deepen user engagement, differentiate Amazfit beyond device specifications, and reinforce ecosystem loyalty.

bear.b: Zepp has improved margins and narrowed losses, but it remains materially unprofitable across recent reporting periods. Until revenue growth converts into sustained operating earnings, the company has less capacity to self-fund product investment, absorb setbacks, or build durable shareholder value.

Negative operating and free cash flow in consecutive years indicates that the business has not yet established a reliable internally funded model. Continued cash consumption can constrain investment flexibility and increase dependence on available liquidity or balance-sheet support if losses persist.

Higher research, marketing, and brand-building costs are currently limiting the earnings benefit from growth, while foreign exchange and product supply constraints delay revenue realization. These pressures could keep profitability below potential even as the company shifts toward higher-value wearables.
